reviews.title: Novelas incompletas
reviews.text: Las novelas están incompletas si no las van a completar deberían quitarlas para no hacer perder el tiempo y dinero al consumidor.

reviews.title: The mighty Charlie Wade
reviews.text: Waste of time. They will take your money for a very long time giving you updates and new chapters regularly. Then all of a sudden stop in the middle of the book. It has been 4 months since any new chapters for me. I do not recommend.

reviews.title: Stolen coins
reviews.text:
I’ve been watching the required 15 adds per day and saving my coins so I can read longer but every time I check in my balance goes down.  In the last couple of weeks hundreds of coins went missing.
Well here I am again….love the story I’m reading but not time every night.  What I don’t understand is I check in every day but after a few days it starts me  back to day 1!
Come on people…just not right!!!

reviews.title: Wouldn’t recommend
reviews.text: It's very expensive. Even if you pay for a subscription, it shows you ads. I can't stand the ads, much less if I paid for a subscription. I don't recommend it.

reviews.title: The price is insane
reviews.text: $15.99 a WEEK for short stories? And by short i mean 8-10 mini chapters? Are yall out of your ever loving minds?!?!

reviews.title: Won’t let me cancel
reviews.text: I tried to cancel several times. Every time I tried said I had points left. I’m down to 15 points last night I found a book that when you needed to get more chapters it cost 15 points exactly what I had . I tried to use it so I would be down to zero points but it wouldn’t let me do it. This is a scam. I’d give it 0 stars if I could. I tried reaching out sent emails but still no luck. Horrible site

reviews.title: Worst App
reviews.text: App does not hold writers accountable. Multiple unfinished books. Charles Wade book. No new chapters for 15 plus days.

reviews.title: Where are my points going!!
reviews.text: I watch 15 ads everyday to earn points only for them to take almost 100 points away every day!!!  How fair is that?  I can see paying points everyday, but not more than I earn.  I will not be using this app anymore.  Even though I am half way finished with my story.  Boo, not good!!

reviews.title: Neverending Ads!
reviews.text: You cannot even get into the the app without ads first. It did not used to be like that, now as soon as you open the app, you have to watch ads first. Not just one ad mind you🤦‍♀️

reviews.title: Not happy
reviews.text: Watched 20 ads and when I went to read book it said I can only read it if I pay for it. Damn I have 10 reading apps and none of them have tried to force me to pay

reviews.title: Why 2 stars?
reviews.text: These apps need to take responsibility for their authors ability to finish or at least regularly provide chapters to a story. We invest time and more importantly MONEY to reading the stories. It’s irresponsible for them to keep us hanging and not finish a story. I’m ready to delete this app. My advice? Don’t start an incomplete story. You’ll be very frustrated.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: I bought an annual subscription, but it wasn’t activated. I cannot even find a way to get help.  Do NOT purchase this!
